The decisive mistake was made by Tickets_Pricing_Expert at Step 2. The agent supplied the daily ticket prices without actually looking them up, and it set the price for children aged 3-5 at $18 and for adults at $20. The correct answer of 45 implies different pricing: the annual passes would have saved $45. The incorrect pricing data propagated into every later calculation. Budgeting_Expert and Verification_Expert only re-checked the arithmetic and never checked the prices.

The annual pass prices in Step 3 were also unverified, but the first erroneous data came in Step 2.

STEP: 2
